evidence.title: Earlier WO 190635453 -> replacement (4 cycles later)
evidence.reason: The earlier work order documents the initial troubleshooting of the same defect (HIL 191326450, Aft Cargo Fire Det Loop A inop), which identified the A1 smoke detector as faulty; because parts were not available at that time, its replacement was deferred to the anchor work order.
evidence.detail:
REF TO HIL 191326450
AFT CARGO FIRE DET LOOP A INOP
T/S C/O IAW FIM 26-16/801 REV 90.
FOUND A1 AND A3 SMOKE DET FAULTY.
A3 SMOKE DETECTOR REPLACED IAW AMM 26-16-01 REV 90.
A1 SMOKE DET PART NOT AVAILABLE.
HIL REMAINS OPEN.

evidence.title: Earlier WO 190249155 -> replacement (8 cycles later)
evidence.reason: The earlier work order directly identified detector B3 as inoperative alongside A2, closed loop A after replacing A2, and raised HIL 190249156 specifically for Loop B remaining inoperative, which is the exact anchor HIL where detector B3 was subsequently replaced.
evidence.detail:
REF HIL 190158047 AND W/O 190158046 AFT CARGO SMOKE DETECTORS A2 AND B3 INOP
AFT CARGO SMOKE DETECTOR A2 REPLACED AND TESTED IAW AMM 26-16-01/401 REV.86
AFT CARGO SMOKE DETECTION LOOP A NOW SERVICEABLE LOOP B STILL INOP.
HIL 190158047 CLOSED.
HIL 190249156 RAISED FOR LOOP B INOP

evidence.title: Earlier WO 190529883 -> replacement (6 cycles later)
evidence.reason: The earlier work order documents that Loop B was already inoperative under HIL 190529876 while troubleshooting Loop A; the anchor work order directly closes that same HIL 190529876 by replacing the faulty Loop B detectors M2245 and M2246.
evidence.detail:
AFT CARGO LOOP "A" SHOWS DETECTOR FAULT.
LOOP "B" ALREADY INOP IAW HIL 190529876.
FIM 26-16 TASK 805 REV.90 PERFORMED AND FOUND DETECTOR M2243 INOPERATIVE.
SMOKE DETECTOR REPLACED AND TESTED SATIS IAW AMM 26-16-01/401 REV.90
AFT CARGO LOOP "A" NOW SERVICEABLE.

evidence.title: Earlier WO 190638587 -> replacement (29 cycles later)
evidence.reason: The earlier work order references the exact same HIL tracking number (190638581) for the aft cargo smoke detection system, explicitly noting that loop 1A/A1 remained faulted and open pending replacement, which was directly completed in the anchor WO.
evidence.detail:
REF TO HIL W/O 190638581 AFT  CARGO B LOOP INOP
PERFORMED CEU BITE TEST PROCEDURE FOUND LOOP 1A AND 1B  IN AFT CARGO FAULT 
REPLACED CARGO BAY SMOKE DETECTOR 1B IAW  AMM 26-16-01/400 REV 86 TEST SATIS 
HIL WILL REMAIN OPEN TILL LOOP 1A REPLACMENT
 W/O PERFORMED WITH BVZ IN OJT

evidence.title: Earlier WO 55504927 -> replacement (1505 cycles later)
evidence.reason: Both work orders involve troubleshooting faults within the aft cargo fire detection loops (ATA 26-16) per FIM 26-16 Task 801/805. The earlier event reported both loops failing and replaced detectors A1 and B3, while the anchor replaced detector B1 due to loop B failing, indicating recurring or emerging degradation within the multi-detector aft cargo fire detection loop system.

BOTH A1 AND B3 AFT CARGO SMOKE DETECTORS REPLACED AND TESTED SATIS IAW AMM 26-16-01/401 REV 85 

ASSISTED BY AGJ, ELJ, CHRY

HIL NOW CLOSED
